title: Local development setup (Mac)
text:
### Local development setup (Mac)
1) Install Xcode CLT, Homebrew
2) asdf install
3) make bootstrap
4) docker compose up
Troubleshooting: reset dev DB with ./scripts/reset-db

title: Requesting production access
text:
Request prod access via Jira: SEC-Access.
Include:
- system name
- justification
- duration
- manager approval
MFA required; access reviewed quarterly.

title: Product roadmap 2026 H2
text:
# Product roadmap 2026 H2
Focus: faster checkout, returns automation, and warehouse visibility.
Themes:
- Latency
- Fraud
- Observability

title: Q3: Checkout performance
text:
Target: p95 < 900ms (web).
Initiatives:
- edge caching for /cart
- reduce GraphQL overfetch
- DB query audit (top 20)
Owner: Platform PM

title: Q4: Returns automation
text:
Scope:
- self-serve label flow
- RMA eligibility rules
- warehouse scanning integration
Risk: carrier API rate limits; add backoff + queue.

title: Launch checklist
text:
## Launch checklist
- Feature flag
- SLOs + dashboards
- Runbook + rollback steps
- Privacy review
- Support macros updated

title: SRE runbook index
text:
# SRE runbook index
Common incidents and links.
- API 5xx spikes
- Queue backlog
- DB failover
PagerDuty: Northwind-Prod

title: API 5xx spike
text:
Symptoms: elevated 5xx, p95 latency up.
Steps:
1) Check deploys in ArgoCD
2) Look at upstream timeouts
3) Scale workers
4) Rollback if error budget burning

title: Queue backlog
text:
If RabbitMQ/Redis queue depth rising:
- verify consumers running
- check rate limiting upstream
- increase concurrency
- drain poison messages to DLQ
Grafana: /d/queues/overview

title: Database saturation quick checks
text:
Checklist:
- CPU steal / IOPS
- slow queries (pg_stat_statements)
- connection pool exhaustion
- vacuum lag
Mitigation: disable expensive report jobs temporarily.

title: Security standards
text:
# Security standards
- MFA required
- Secrets in Vault only
- Quarterly access reviews
- PII in prod requires ticket + approval
Contact: security@northwind.example

title: Vendor risk review process
text:
Use the vendor intake form, then complete:
- SOC2 report review
- data flow diagram
- DPA signed
- pen test summary
SLA: 10 business days for standard vendors.

title: Password policy (draft)
text:
Draft notes:
- minimum 14 chars
- passphrases preferred
- no periodic rotation unless compromise
- enforce breached password checks
Need alignment with IT before publishing.

title: Customer support playbook
text:
# Customer support playbook
Tone: clear, kind, and specific.
Escalate:
- payment issues
- account takeovers
- outages
Macros live in Zendesk > Admin > Macros.

title: Refund policy guidelines
text:
Refunds:
- < 30 days: approve if unused
- fraud/ATO: always escalate
- shipping delays: offer credit first
Include order id and last 4 of card in ticket notes.

title: Outage comms template
text:
Template:
- What happened
- Impacted users
- Mitigation
- Next update time
Post to status page + email major accounts.
Use incident channel in Slack for coordination.

title: Data warehouse (Snowflake) conventions
text:
Naming:
- schemas: raw, staging, marts
- tables: snake_case
- primary keys: <entity>_id
Partition large facts by event_date.
Owner: Analytics Eng.

title: dbt deployment checklist
text:
Before merge:
- `dbt build` passes
- exposures updated
- tests added for new models
After merge:
- verify prod run
- backfill if needed
- update Looker explores

title: Ad hoc query tips
text:
Tips:
- always filter on event_date
- avoid SELECT * in marts
- use QUALIFY for window filters
- document assumptions in the ticket
Saved queries live in Mode Analytics.

title: Design system: buttons
text:
Button rules:
- primary: solid, brand color
- secondary: outline
- destructive: red
Sizes: sm/md/lg
Do not mix icon-only buttons without aria-labels.

title: Figma libraries and naming
text:
Figma:
- Libraries: Northwind UI, Icons
- Components: `Button / Primary / md`
- Use tokens for color/spacing
Publish changes weekly; note breaking changes in #design-systems.

title: Deprecated color tokens
text:
These tokens are being phased out:
- brandBlue500
- grayWarm200
Use the new semantic tokens: `text.primary`, `surface.raised`, `border.muted`.
Archive after 2026-09.

title: Finance: month-end close
text:
Month-end close timeline:
- Day 1: invoices + accruals
- Day 3: revenue recognition checks
- Day 5: management review
Systems: Netsuite, Ramp, Stripe reports.

title: Expense policy exceptions
text:
Exceptions require CFO approval:
- international per diem overrides
- client gifts > $200
- travel booked outside Concur
Add receipts and business purpose to the request.

title: Legal: contract templates
text:
Templates:
- MSA (standard)
- DPA (EU)
- NDA (mutual)
All edits via Google Docs with track changes.
For redlines, open a ticket in LEG-Queue.

title: Data processing addendum notes
text:
Key points:
- subprocessors list must be current
- breach notification: 72 hours
- data retention: 30 days post-termination unless required
Route questions to legal@northwind.example.

title: Marketing: brand voice
text:
Brand voice:
- confident, not cute
- avoid jargon
- show numbers when possible
Examples:
- "Ships next day"
- "p95 checkout under 1s"

title: Campaign QA checklist
text:
Before send:
- UTM params (source/medium/campaign)
- unsubscribe link works
- preview on mobile
- landing page loads < 2s
- legal footer present
Owner: Demand Gen

title: HR: performance review rubric
text:
Rubric:
- Impact
- Collaboration
- Craft
- Ownership
Use examples from the last 6 months.
Calibration happens in the last week of June and December.

title: Promotion packet template
text:
Include:
- summary of scope change
- 3-5 impact bullets (metrics)
- peer feedback quotes
- manager recommendation
Attach relevant PRDs, incident reports, or demos.
